minutes.headline: School Committee held a 75-minute interview with superintendent finalist Jodi Fortuna; no hiring vote taken.
minutes.summary: This was a special School Committee meeting devoted entirely to interviewing Jodi Fortuna, a finalist candidate for superintendent, currently deputy superintendent in Brookline and a former superintendent in Hudson, MA. Members asked prepared questions covering budgeting, community relations, student safety, staff culture, hiring practices and leadership style, and Fortuna gave an opening and closing statement; the meeting ended with a roll-call vote to adjourn and no vote on the candidacy itself.

what_happened.line: School Committee interviewed superintendent finalist Jodi Fortuna for about an hour, and took no vote on her candidacy.
Fortuna, currently deputy superintendent in Brookline and a former superintendent in Hudson, described her budgeting process and how she communicates budget tradeoffs to a community.

She was asked about a prior controversy over an assistant-principal hire at Turkey Hill and online harassment that followed, and how she would respond to a hypothetical ICE visit at the primary school.
The meeting closed with a roll-call vote to adjourn; no decision on the superintendent search was recorded.

why_it_matters: The next superintendent will run the school district's budget process residents review every year, including how tradeoffs and cuts get explained to the public.
No hiring vote occurred at this meeting, so the choice of superintendent remains open.
